info.title: Salesbuildr Public API
info.description:
This page describes the [Salesbuildr Public API](/public-api).

You can also use the [Interactive Swagger docs](/public-api/swagger)

**[View Webhooks Documentation](/public-api/webhooks)** - Learn how to receive real-time notifications for events in your Salesbuildr account.

Rate limiting applies to all endpoints, except those where it is explicitly mentioned otherwise. The rate limit is 500 requests per 10 minutes.

The API response headers contain information about the current usage and expiration under the prefix `X-RateLimit-`.
Once the limit is reached, the API will return a 429 status code with a header `Retry-After`, indicating the wait time in seconds.
